# strided-rs v0.5.0

## Performance

- **View metadata is borrowed or owned, never refcounted ([#297](https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/pull/297)).**
  `StridedView`, `StridedViewMut` and `StridedArray` stored shape and strides as
  `Arc<[usize]>` / `Arc<[isize]>`, so every construction made two allocations and, on drop, two
  atomic refcount operations. A view's metadata is now `Cow<'_, [_]>`: `StridedView::new` borrows
  the caller's layout and allocates nothing, `new_owned` takes a layout computed next to the view,
  and the derived views (`permute`, `broadcast`, `diagonal_view`, `transpose_2d`, `adjoint_2d`) plus
  `StridedArray` own theirs as `Vec`, which is never shared. Measured on one core with the same
  example compiled both ways: one `StridedView::new` drops from 26.8 ns to 2.7 ns, three views from
  81.3 ns to 7.7 ns, and a host's warm binary-plan call through views from 92.5 ns to 20.2 ns
  against 18.7 ns through the slice entry — the per-call wrapper cost falls from 74.2 ns to
  1.6 ns. `strided-view` no longer names `Arc`, and `RawStridedRef`'s `as_view`/`as_view_mut`
  conversions borrow instead of allocating.

## New

- **`ExecContext::run_on` ([#297](https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/pull/297)).**
  Runs an operation on a caller-supplied Rayon pool instead of whichever pool happens to be
  installed: the width is clamped to the pool, a width of one stays on the calling thread, and a
  call from a worker of the same pool runs in place rather than nesting a team. Until now the only
  way to place strided fanout was to install a pool at every call site, and a caller that forgot
  landed on the global pool — a second worker team beside its own.

## Compatibility

Breaking. A view's layout now has to outlive the view: `StridedView::new` takes `&'a [usize]` /
`&'a [isize]`, and a metadata expression that was a non-promoted temporary must be bound first or
passed to `new_owned`. `StridedView::clone()` copies a borrowed layout reference instead of
bumping a refcount; `StridedArray`'s metadata is a `Vec`, so its `Clone` copies it alongside the
data it already copied. `RawStridedRef`/`RawStridedMut` are unchanged.

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/tensor4all/strided-rs/compare/v0.4.8...v0.5.0
